excludedAdapterAttempt.reason: JSON list header pairs must be converted to Python tuples. Curl explicit-header branch raised UnboundLocalError before network; stopped on first public control. Four control observations excluded from transport success comparison.

findings: Each of the four profiles matched 2/14: GitHub and arXiv only. No profile recovered any of the twelve selected persistent failures.
Diagnostics verified HTTP/1.1 for the two H1 profiles and HTTP/2 for Undici-H2 and curl. Curl had different observed TLS and HTTP/2 fingerprints; neither added coverage here.
All three Undici profiles emitted an empty Cookie header on the diagnostic endpoint; curl did not. This is an observed confound and does not establish that Cookie caused a target failure.
American Airlines produced one raw HTML marker match in undici-default but its exact expected text appeared only in non-content markup. The frozen normalized score remains a failure.
Neiman Marcus and LinkedIn had transport failures, not measured WAF HTTP denials in these observations; no vendor rule is inferred from those failures.
decision: No production transport, headers or routing change: this selected one-round experiment established no coverage gain. Do not infer full API performance or hosted parity from static-client observations.
limits: Four simultaneous profiles share one egress and live targets; this is one selected round, not a population or WAF-vendor rate.
Header ordering, empty cookies, TLS/protocol implementation, and OS bundles differ; the curl comparison does not isolate TLS alone.
Prototype performs no JavaScript, readiness, consent, navigation workflows, caller actions or retained sessions. It cannot satisfy browserControls.
The prior full API normalized result remains 55/100. The earlier actual hosted result was 81/100 and was not rerun for this experiment.
